688:t_3:26.en:
$$シャア$$
「And, following his own desires, he sought chaos and tried to steer the world's course so that war would continue.」

688:t_3:27.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Indeed. That is $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$.」

688:t_3:28.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「But he is merely one component of the person called 'me.'」

688:t_3:30.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you planning to confuse us with your favorite trick, your silver tongue?」

688:t_3:32.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Are you... 《$$エルガン#keyword$$》 $$ローディック$$?」

688:t_3:33.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's correct. But he, too, is merely one component of 'me.'」

688:t_3:34.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I am now a collective of the $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$s who exist in various worlds.」

688:t_3:36.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're saying there's a whole bunch of $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$s inside old man $$ジエー$$'s body!?」

688:t_3:37.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「By the way, the name '$$ＡＧ$$' is short for 'All Gathered.'」

688:t_3:38.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「And their representative is me! $$ジエー・ベイベル$$, nya~!」

688:t_3:39.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I'd appreciate it if you didn't appoint yourself our representative.」

688:t_3:40.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「But it's true! I'm the supreme authority among these personalities!」

688:t_3:41.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You should thank me for pulling your consciousness out at the moment you died, nya~!」

688:t_3:42.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I-I don't really understand what's happening...」

688:t_3:43.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You should understand what we sought by uniting our consciousnesses.」

688:t_3:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Understanding and accepting others... then advancing into the future together...」

688:t_3:45.en:
$$刹那$$
「Were you trying... to attain $$シンカ$$?」

688:t_3:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And you used artificial means to do it.」

688:t_3:47.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's right, nya~! That's just what I'd expect from an inheritor, an $$イノベイター$$, and a $$ニュータイプ$$!」

688:t_3:48.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「...Let me explain in order.」

688:t_3:49.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「The influence of $$黒の英知$$ taught us of the despairing future... of the $$御使い$$s, before even the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s learned of them.」

688:t_3:50.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「To avert it, the $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$s of various worlds tried various measures.」

688:t_3:51.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「One of them was the $$時空震動弾$$, nya~.」

688:t_3:53.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「A $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ somewhere built it to flee to another world and escape the $$御使い$$s, nya~.」

688:t_3:54.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Though, thanks to various flaws, it ended up causing the $$大時空震動$$, nya~.」

688:t_3:55.en:
$$オルソン$$
「For something incomplete, its effects were immeasurably vast.」

688:t_3:56.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I can't say anything definitive about that...」

688:t_3:57.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Even we couldn't travel easily between parallel worlds before the $$大時空震動$$, so much about each world's situation remains unknown.」

688:t_3:58.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「By the way, $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$ＵＮ$$ was another grand experiment of mine, nya~.」

688:t_3:60.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Thanks to $$黒の英知$$, I... had a vague understanding of the truth needed for $$シンカ$$ too, nya~.」

688:t_3:61.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「So I gathered countless people's knowledge in virtual space to create collective intelligence and consciousness, hoping to observe $$シンカ$$ emerging from it, nya~.」

688:t_3:62.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「It ended in failure, though.」

688:t_3:63.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't talk like it had nothing to do with you! How much hell do you think we went through because of that!?」

688:t_3:64.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Just so you know, I... wasn't playing around in $$ＵＣＷ$$ to escape reality.」

688:t_3:65.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Even $$カイメラ$$'s $$カオス・シリーズ$$ was part of the plan to defeat the $$御使い$$s, nya~.」

688:t_3:67.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「$$ツィーネ$$'s $$カオス・カペル$$ was to reproduce the power of the $$知りたがる山羊$$ $$スフィア$$ that $$アサキム$$ showed me...」

688:t_3:68.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「《$$レーベン$$》, who endured his hatred of women, had the $$カオス・レオー$$ for an experiment to steal $$ガンレオン$$'s $$スフィア$$...」

688:t_3:70.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「《$$シュラン$$》's $$カオス・アングイス$$ was for an experiment using Ophiuchus's $$次元力|lc$$, second only to the twelve zodiac constellations, nya~.」

688:t_3:71.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「So you used me... used $$カイメラ$$ for that?」

688:t_3:72.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Your anger's misplaced, $$ツィーネ$$, nya~. We just came together in that filthy, tangled world to pursue our own goals, nya~.」

688:t_3:73.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「It's through chaos that humans evolve! That's my theory, nya~!」

688:t_3:74.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「How far can you possibly...!」

688:t_3:75.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「In fact, $$ＵＣＷ$$ was like a treasure chest, nya~.」

688:t_3:76.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「And my greatest find inside it was all of you in $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$.」

688:t_3:79.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Because you overcame the malice I planted and came to understand one another, nya~.」

688:t_3:80.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Then you even showed me friendship across planets and love across species. Honestly, I had to take my hat off to you.」

688:t_3:81.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「To top it off, you defeated my $$カオス・レムレース$$, and I learned the power of the $$スフィア$$s firsthand, nya~.」

688:t_3:82.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Even though I'd installed '$$天獄$$', a system to seal those $$御使い$$ bastards away, nya~.」

688:t_3:83.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So that was... the truth hidden behind the $$多元戦争$$...」

688:t_3:84.en:
$$シャア$$
「So $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ was gathering strength to fight the despairing future rather than flee it...」

688:t_3:85.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That still doesn't mean we can forgive what this guy did...!」

688:t_3:86.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「By the way, the $$ジェミニオン$$ I envisioned was a redesigned, compact $$カオス・レムレース$$ using data from the $$カオス・シリーズ$$.」

688:t_3:87.en:
$n
「So the $$ジェミニオン$$ was really... a machine built by the man who plunged $$ＵＣＷ$$ into chaos...」

688:t_3:88.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see. So that's where 'the mechanical devil' comes from.」

688:t_3:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then, in the end, the organization called $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$ never existed?」

688:t_3:91.en:
$n
「You...! So you were lying to us after all!」

688:t_3:92.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Ah, stop! Don't hurt my pretty face!」

688:t_3:93.en:
$n
「What the hell is with this guy!?」

688:t_3:94.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Don't recoil from me, $n! We've been fighting together all this time, haven't we?」

688:t_3:95.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...$$エルガン・ローディック$$... Would you please continue your explanation?」

688:t_3:97.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「After $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ contacted us, we each sought the $$スフィア$$s, and fortunately, we obtained one.」

688:t_3:98.en:
$$トライア$$
「That was the $$揺れる天秤$$...」

688:t_3:99.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Correct. I entrusted it to $$カルロス・アクシオン$$ Jr., who tried to destroy the world ruled by $$クロノ$$, but...」

688:t_3:100.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「It ultimately passed to Dr. $$トライア$$ and was installed in $$クロウ・ブルースト$$'s machine.」

688:t_3:101.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I had no idea all that happened before my $$ブラスタ$$ was completed...」

688:t_3:102.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「But at the same time, we learned that $$スフィア・リアクター$$s aren't easy to handle and won't do whatever we want, nya~.」

688:t_3:103.en:
$$ロラン$$
「People might help Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$, but nobody would cooperate with someone like you!」

688:t_3:104.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「However, it is a fact that $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ possesses the greatest power among the $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$s.」

688:t_3:105.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「So I... thought about how I could make the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s do whatever I wanted...」
